verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and back-office SaaS, so letting users schedule recurring workflows is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The pack shows only vendor-managed recurring services: deadline tracking, annual report and franchise tax filings, and automated sales tax filings. These are adjacent features, not user-configurable scheduled jobs. No public API spec or scheduling interface turned up, since the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.
